newsitem.title: USA: Midcom relocating, CFO not coming.
newsitem.headline: Midcom relocating, CFO not coming.

text.p: Midcom Communications Inc said Friday that it will begin to move its Seattle-based corporate headquarters to Southfield, Michigan, with completion expected in early fall 1997.
Midcom said that of its 684 total employees, the relocation plan will affect about 130 employees. Relocation packages will be offered to Seattle employees.

The company said that Robert Chamberlain, currently executive vice president and chief financial officer, and Robert Nitschke, currently executive vice president of operations, have elected not to relocate to Southfield, but will continue to serve in their current positions with the company until the transition is successfully completed.
The company has had significant operations functions based in Southfield since mid-1996, along with its marketing and product development departments.
